filename_assessment.finding: The designated originals already match the helper rule; required ignored staging copies were nevertheless created and verified byte-identical.

baseline_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines: physical-page<TAB>filename<TAB>page-sha256<LF>, in physical-page order

restoration.purpose: Recreate the ignored staging and canonical cache without modifying designated originals.
procedure: Read the pages rows in project/W2/source-map.json.
Create project/W2/local-staging/W2 if absent and copy each original_file there with a metadata-preserving byte copy; do not rename or overwrite originals.
Verify each staging destination SHA-256 equals that row's sha256.
Run python workflow/scripts/source_md.py ingest project/W2 project/W2/local-staging/W2 --source-id W2 on a fresh W2 project manifest.
Verify each canonical destination SHA-256 equals that row's sha256 and the canonical filename set contains exactly 398 files.
restoration.copy_mode: byte-preserving copy; no re-rendering or image transformation
restoration.verification: Compare original_file, staging_file, and canonical_image hashes for every row.
